summary: This directory manages configuration options for architectural analysis, defining how concepts and metadata are structured, tracked, and tailored to project-specific paths during the document construction and analysis workflows.
responsibilities: Define configuration schemas for architectural analysis
Enable path tracking and change detection for generated concepts
Provide interfaces for customizing analysis parameters
relationships: Configuration options extend the base analysis logic by providing path-specific directives.
Analysis metadata structures utilize these options to track changes across project lifecycle stages.
designDecisions: Extension of base analysis interfaces to ensure type safety
Separation of AI-specific configuration from project structure definitions
